content.value_statement: UniFi teams need clear reviews of zones, ACLs, and guest access. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through audits, policy checks, and compliance-ready summaries.
actual_capabilities: Guides review of UniFi firewall zones and network segmentation.
Guides review of access control rules and policy purpose.
Supports checks of hotspot voucher status and expiration.
Produces structured security audit findings and recommendations.
Helps verify compliance posture from available UniFi network data.
limitations: Requires access to compatible UniFi network management tools.
Does not replace a formal penetration test or legal compliance review.
Cannot verify physical network controls or undocumented business policies.
Recommendations depend on the completeness of available configuration data.

use_cases.title: Quarterly Security Review
use_cases.description: Review firewall zones, ACLs, and guest access before a scheduled compliance check.

use_cases.title: Guest Access Cleanup
use_cases.description: Find active, expired, and soon-expiring vouchers so guest access can be controlled.

use_cases.title: Segmentation Assessment
use_cases.description: Compare zone design and access rules against least privilege and trust boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: List Security Objects
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current firewall zones, ACL rules, and guest vouchers. Summarize anything that needs attention.

prompt_templates.title: Review Guest Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Review active guest vouchers and identify expired, expiring, or unusually broad access. Recommend cleanup actions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Segmentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess firewall zones and ACL rules for segmentation gaps. Highlight rules that may violate least privilege.

prompt_templates.title: Create Compliance Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full security audit using zones, ACLs, guest vouchers, and network info. Provide risks, evidence, and prioritized recommendations.

output_examples.output: A concise audit report with firewall zone status, ACL observations, guest voucher risks, compliance notes, and prioritized remediation steps.
A rule-by-rule summary showing purpose, affected zones, potential over-permission, and suggested least privilege changes.

output_examples.input: List active guest network vouchers and their status.
output_examples.output: A guest access summary with active vouchers, expiration concerns, stale entries, and recommended lifecycle actions.

best_practices: Review firewall zones and ACLs on a regular schedule.
Confirm each rule has a documented business purpose.
Remove expired guest vouchers and narrow active guest access.
anti_patterns: Using broad allow rules without documented justification.
Leaving guest vouchers active after the intended access window.
Treating generated recommendations as final without operator review.

faq.question: What UniFi areas does this skill review?
faq.answer: It focuses on firewall zones, access control rules, hotspot vouchers, network information, and related security posture.

faq.question: Can it change firewall rules automatically?
faq.answer: The skill describes review and management workflows. Confirm any configuration change through your approved UniFi administration process.

faq.question: Does it support compliance reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize findings, risks, and recommendations into a compliance-oriented security review.

faq.question: Is this a penetration testing tool?
faq.answer: No. It reviews available configuration data and policy posture, but it does not perform exploit testing.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data should I verify before using it?
faq.answer: Confirm that UniFi tool access is current and that zones, ACLs, vouchers, and network information are available.
